title: The dino who was scared of the puddle
summary: The biggest dinosaur in the whole valley is terrified of the tiniest thing you can imagine.

scenes.text: Tobi was the biggest dinosaur in the whole valley. When he walked, his footsteps went boom, boom, boom!, and the leaves on the trees trembled as if they were being tickled. Everyone thought Tobi wasn't scared of anything. But Tobi kept a very, very tiny secret. Next to his nest there was a puddle. Not a river, not a lake: a teeny puddle, the size of a hat. And every time Tobi saw it shine, his giant knees wobbled and he hid his big head behind his tail. "What if it splashes me? What if it swallows me?", thought the enormous dinosaur, trembling because of a little puddle.

To avoid getting close to the puddle, Tobi did very funny things. He took the longest way around the valley. He walked on tiptoe, slowly, glancing sideways. One day, trying to dodge it, he made such a clumsy hop that he sat right on top of a bush. The wind blew and ruffled the crest on his head. The little birds watching him let out a soft giggle, "hee, hee, hee." Tobi turned red all the way to the tip of his tail. "I'm not scared!", he said loudly. But the moment the puddle shone again, he ran off and hid behind a rock. An enormous dinosaur, hiding from something so tiny.

Out of the puddle popped, plip, a little green frog. She sat on a floating leaf and looked at Tobi with kind eyes. "Why are you scared of the water?", asked the frog. "It's only a little puddle. I live here, and it's soft and cool." The little frog splashed slowly, without any fear. "Come on, just dip one toe," she said. Tobi gulped. He stretched out the biggest foot in the valley, slowly, slowly... and touched the water with his little claw. Nothing bad happened. The water tickled him. The frog smiled. "See? The puddle doesn't bite," she said. And Tobi, for the very first time, did not run away.

Then Tobi took a deep breath, counted to three and... jumped into the puddle! SPLASH! The water flew up and fell like happy rain. Bubbles came out everywhere: fat ones, tiny ones, round ones. Tobi stayed still for a second... and then let out a huge belly laugh. "Ha, ha, ha! Nothing happens! It's soft!" He splashed and splashed, sprinkling the frog, who laughed with him. The puddle, which had seemed like a monster before, was now the best toy in the valley. The biggest dinosaur wasn't scared of the smallest puddle anymore. He had only needed a little bit of courage.

When night came, the valley turned quiet and blue. Tobi and the frog sat together beside the puddle. In the still water they could see the moon, round and white, like a silver button. And all around twinkled the stars, tiny, like crumbs of light. An owl sang softly from a tree. "Good night, brave one," whispered the frog. Tobi gave a big yawn, rested his big head on his paws and smiled. His knees didn't wobble anymore. He closed his eyes slowly, slowly, and fell asleep listening to the water sing quietly. And he dreamed he was jumping in a thousand puddles, happy, with no fear, until morning.
